headline: Halloween Candy Sales Lag as Consumers Battle High Cocoa and Living Costs
summary: U.S. Halloween candy sales got off to a slow start as consumers grapple with high living costs and surging global chocolate and cocoa prices driven by tight market conditions.
why: Elevated commodity prices for key ingredients like cocoa directly compress profit margins for food manufacturers and impact discretionary retail spending.

impacts.name: Consumer Goods
impacts.why: Soaring input costs and strained consumer budgets reduce sales volumes for seasonal confections.
